facts.fact: Kamalakshi does not name at the dusk; her Resin House page stays unburned in Neela's keeping. Neela notices at once, says aloud that she holds the leash she refused, and promises to read the page to Kamalakshi at first light, in daylight, after which it is hers to keep or burn.
Bhaskaran's fingertips are resin-raw from smearing Kuttu's throat and wrists with his bare fingers.
Usha's cuff tears the pared seam on her wrist at her naming; the matching welt rises on Queen Nirmala's forearm, which is what stings.
Neela feels a real pull toward the queen's page-free offer for Lata's safety before refusing it.
